tweet.text:
Last night, Mexican forces captured senior Sinaloa Cartel leader “El Chapo Isidro” in an operation by the Mexican government supported by a coordinated interagency effort that included @HSTaskForce. This successful operation removed a leader of one of the most dangerous drug cartels in Mexico.

We commend Mexico’s military and special forces for carrying out the operation as part of our bilateral effort to eliminate terrorists in Mexico. We extend our deepest condolences to the families of the elite soldiers who were killed during the operation.
